purpose: Attended AP-start ladder: run the proven C2 calibration boot + mode-1 VAP base, then post the reverse-engineered AP-start sequence and decide from READ-ONLY evidence whether the firmware accepted the AP configuration.

prerequisites.firmware: PD4-patched vendor firmware, golden cold boot page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD state 1
prerequisites.modules: cfg80211.ko + clean-room hi5622_wifi.ko v3 built from the hardware-fired wifi-scan-complete/src base (748,888 B b42ff4ec) + wifi-ap-start provider patch (ap_start_mode selectable)
prerequisites.recovery: recovery door armed, UART capture running (read-only), bench link PASS

module_params.note: ap_start_mode 0 = g0 id1 static keys (default, statically dispatched by firmware table A); 1 = vendor WAL g2 envelopes (needs the dynamic group-2 handler; fallback only).  v3 module: 206,060 B sha256 90dd28505f23425fd7ea84847027ab909405b083332a3a5141f3d76da878a79f (see ../HOSTAPD-BRINGUP.md).

readback_pack.name: golden page
readback_pack.expect: 0x86807FEF, state 1, mask 0 at CA 0x40008, staging 0 at BAR0 0x6F800C

readback_pack.name: module-table slot 0
readback_pack.expect: 0 before the VAP base, nonzero afterwards

readback_pack.name: vap0 pointer
readback_pack.expect: nonzero after the mode-1 VAP add

readback_pack.name: ctx0 flags 0x18c
readback_pack.expect: changes after AP config (mode/HT flags set by worker 0x84DA4); lead's boot: BAR0 0x7D18E4

readback_pack.name: ctx0 flags 0x18d
readback_pack.expect: bit0 = hidden SSID, bit2 = band/mode flag

readback_pack.name: vap0+0x64 flags
readback_pack.expect: bits cleared/set by the AP-config worker

readback_pack.name: vap0+0x13a MDID
readback_pack.expect: 0 when no MD IE, else IE payload[0..1]

ladder.action: read-only golden pack before any write
ladder.on_fail: stop: do not load modules or post frames

ladder.action: boot ladder + C2 calibration (ctx_create type 1, txq_sync72, six cfg_cal 3502..3507)
ladder.expect: all frames consumed, rd_catalog g1 id3 count increases, mask 0
ladder.on_fail: stop and keep the C2 evidence; AP ladder requires the active core

ladder.action: mode-1 VAP base: iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type managed -> g0 id1 key 0x64 (48 B) + key 0x65 (40 B) posts (vap_start_mode=1, vap_start_first=1)
ladder.expect: both frames CONSUMED, mask 0, module-table slot 0 nonzero, ctx0+0x190 nonzero
ladder.on_fail: stop: the AP-config worker requires the module-0 VAP object

ladder.action: hostapd-open.conf start (NL80211_CMD_NEW_BEACON -> driver start_ap -> provider ap_start_mode=0 posts frame 0 'ap_ssid' = g0 id1 key 0x0005, 64 B)
ladder.expect: frame CONSUMED in the bounded poll, mask 0, dmesg 'start_ap sequence frame 1/4 ap_ssid posted'
ladder.on_fail: stop: a refused SSID frame means the gate/budget is wrong, not the wire

ladder.action: continue the same start_ap: frame 1 'ap_cfg' = g0 id1 key 0x0127, 184 B (156-byte body: beacon_interval 100, dtim 2, hidden 0, RSN IE at +0x09 for WPA2, mode 5 for HT)
ladder.expect: frame CONSUMED in the bounded poll, mask 0; then readback: vap0+0x10 == 100, vap0+0x14 == 2, ctx0+0x18c/0x18d changed
ladder.on_fail: stop; capture the readback pack before any retry

ladder.action: hostapd stays up; read iw dev wlan0 info and dmesg
ladder.expect: type AP reported; no exception; heartbeats continue.  Beaconing itself is NOT observable from the host radio - do not claim an AP

ladder.action: optional second rung: same ladder with ap_start_mode=1 (WAL g2 cmd 0x05/0x6D/0x127/0x65)
ladder.expect: all four frames CONSUMED, mask 0, same readback changes; if not, the static g0 carrier stays the supported path
ladder.on_fail: classify WAL g2 as dynamic-handler-only [U]; keep mode 0

stop_rules: exception mask CA 0x40008 != 0 or a nonzero staging frame at BAR0 0x6F800C
golden page 0x86807FEF/7/2/0xABCD, state 1 or g+0xB4/+0xB8 changes
any posted frame is not consumed inside the provider's bounded poll (h2d_status refused/timeout increments)
any dmesg fault, or the module reports the H2D lane closed
never re-send a frame in the same boot after a stop; power-cycle and analyse offline
never write CA 0x400392F0 (out[5]), never post mailbox id 5, never send group 1/4
claim_rules: PASS on A2 requires the firmware readback match - a consumed frame alone is not an AP
beaconing over the air is out of scope for this host-only lane; the gate is firmware context acceptance
hostapd reaching start_ap is a host-side fact; it is not proof of an operational AP

hostapd_flow.preconditions: C2 ladder done (core ACTIVE); ucode files at /usr/share/hostap/; regdb installed
commands: phase_matrix.py --phase C2    (or the manual boot/C2 ladder)
iw phy phy0 interface add wlan0 type __ap
hostapd_flow.expected: dmesg 'start_ap sequence frame 1/4 ap_ssid posted (64 B)' + 'frame 2/4 ap_cfg posted (184 B)' + 'start_ap sequence posted'; hostapd 'wlan0: AP-ENABLED'

expect_failures.auth/connect gate: old module without the v2 .connect op
expect_failures.add_key: WPA2 config - use OPEN first; keys are M3
expect_failures.NO_IR: regulatory - iw reg set US before start_ap

hostapd_configs.hostapd-open.conf: 2.4 GHz ch 6, OPEN, no HT/WMM, ssid cudy-ap-test (first AP fire)
hostapd_configs.hostapd-wpa2.conf: 2.4 GHz ch 6, WPA2-PSK/CCMP (later rung; needs add_key M3)
